source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The article concerns minimax estimation of L1 distance between two discrete distributions, including the unknown-unknown case and effective sample-size enlargement; it is a proper normalized-L1 comparator rather than a theorem for observational arm ratios.

The paper develops composite fuzzy-hypothesis lower bounds and polynomial/Hermite estimation for the Gaussian l1 norm of normal means; it supplies a methodological template, not the causal result claimed here.

The paper defines the optimal-value parameter, characterizes its pathwise differentiability, and develops inference at possibly exceptional laws; it does not analyze a growing unrestricted categorical alphabet.
